columns.name: num_games
columns.description: The number of games published by the publisher, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_puzzle_games
columns.description: The number of puzzle games published by the publisher, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: oldest_published_game
columns.description: The name of the oldest game published by the publisher, with ties broken by the ascending order of the game name.

columns.name: published_only_one_game
columns.description: Set to 1 if the publisher has published only one game, otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: avg_sale_greater_than_90_per_of_avg_sale_in_Japan
columns.description: Set to 1 if the publisher's average sale in Japan is greater than 90% of the average sales of all publishers in Japan, otherwise, set to 0
